source.note: an internal tracker; no outside source applies, and its clauses are internal ids

rows.requirement: Each event says how its input reached the kernel.
rows.mechanism: Each event records its attestation tier (absent = produced in this kernel; adapter; ha-bridged).
rows.limits: A recorded label, not a check of the source.

rows.requirement: Each event names the ruleset that produced it, and history is never reprocessed under another.
rows.mechanism: ruleset_id and ruleset_hash are bound into each event; ReprocessGuard refuses a mismatch (Invariant VI).
rows.limits: Binds the ruleset label: ruleset_hash is SHA-256 of the id string (src/lib.rs:1614-1616).

rows.requirement: A kit says how its events were captured.
rows.mechanism: A capture-path summary in the court kit: event counts by tier, kernel version and ruleset.

rows.requirement: A Canary's own signature over its record is checked before the hub seals it.
rows.mechanism: The hub verifies a Canary record against a pinned Canary key and records a pin reference, never the key bytes.

rows.requirement: Raw frames are signed at capture.
rows.reason: A signature over raw frames at capture is a content-comparable value over raw media — the correlation substrate §3 rejects; Canaries sign semantic records instead.

rows.requirement: The detection configuration behind a ruleset id is fixed.
rows.mechanism: No ruleset document exists to hash; the id is a label.
rows.operator_action: Change ruleset_id whenever the detection configuration changes.
rows.limits: No ruleset document exists to hash.
